method: All 11 original studio views inspected before source. All six world frames inspected separately. Scores are subjective; occluded frames are not clearance evidence.
positiveFindings: Compact two-storey main mass and lower clay-roof left workroom read as one building. Main roof has the correct steeper-top/flatter-eave sweep and continuous visible soffit in clay. Both chimneys remain planted. Openings are authored coherently rather than duplicated. Continuous terrace supports the complete isolated module.

boundedCorrection.pixelFinding: Front annex barge continues through the main left-wall junction onto the upper front facade, obvious in front/front-left/top and clay-front. The jetty corbel near the main front door center descends onto the arch crown in front/front-left views.
boundedCorrection.sourceDiagnosis: Workroom barge ends at x=-0.66 while main upper wall is x=-0.825; front barge z=0.71 is forward of the upper shell face z=0.66. Front corbel at x=0.24 spans y=0.87..1.035 immediately over the arched opening centered x=0.32, bottom=0.09,height=0.82, with stone reveal above it.
boundedCorrection.correction: Terminate annex trim cleanly into the main wall junction and move/fit the front corbel clear of the arch opening. Preserve accepted main roof, annex volume, terrace and root transform.
boundedCorrection.requiredResult: Attachment clearance at least 0.89 (+0.10); all critical views/categories at least 0.85; no regression over 0.05.
boundedCorrection.watchItem: Left upper side window has a small clearance between annex roof and main eave. It appears tight rather than definitely intersecting; retain a visible gap and allow room for finish without expanding it.

assembly.findings: Moved scene crate/barrel clear the main door and step. A small green shrub with orange tips remains directly in the workroom doorway/threshold, visible in world0/45. New low annex retains a visible gap to cottage02; right neighbor and guild separation remain clear in elevated45/135. Rear sill is unobstructed.
assembly.boundedCorrection: Remove or move only the shrub occupying the workroom threshold; retain other dressing and frozen buildings.
assembly.supportEvidenceNeeded: Rear terrace is visibly supported centrally by retained rock lobes, but its wider outer rear corners project over the coastline shelf. These high views do not prove a floating gap; check actual corner ground contact numerically or in a lower diagnostic before final support acceptance. This is an evidence hold, not an instruction to add support without diagnosis.
assembly.limitations: World90 is fully blocked by a foreground roof. World270 is partially occluded. Elevated and front/rear views carry the neighbor-clearance evidence.

release: Finish withheld pending corrected architectural contacts and assembly evidence.
remainingTargetGap: Macro only. Slate/clay courses, stonework, timber, shutters, smoking-fish details and hardware are intentionally absent. No exact inferred-reference identity claimed.
